note: The workshop's seed shelf. Real books, one line each, written for this workshop rather than copied from a publisher. Each book carries a small closed vocabulary so a cheap deterministic pass can narrow the field before anything smarter is asked to choose: genre (1-2), mood (2-3), pace, themes (2-4), audience. A value nobody else uses is a value that matches nothing, so keep to the lists in vocab.

books.title: The Dispossessed
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.note: Two worlds, one that owns things and one that does not, and a physicist stuck between them.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.note: An envoy on a frozen planet where nobody has a fixed gender, learning how slowly trust is built.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.note: A gifted boy makes one bad choice and spends the rest of the book catching up to it.

books.title: Oryx and Crake
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.note: A man alone after the world ends, working out how the clever people around him ended it.

books.title: The Handmaid's Tale
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.note: A woman kept for one purpose in a country that used to be familiar.

books.title: Station Eleven
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.note: A travelling theatre company after a flu, and the small things people carry forward.

books.title: Sea of Tranquility
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.note: Three centuries, one strange moment in a wood, and a detective who cannot let it go.

books.title: The Marrow Thieves
books.author: Cherie Dimaline
books.note: In a future where most people have lost the ability to dream, a family runs north.

books.title: Five Little Indians
books.author: Michelle Good
books.note: Five survivors of a residential school, in Vancouver, finding out what carrying on costs.

books.title: A Canticle for Leibowitz
books.author: Walter M. Miller Jr.
books.note: Monks keep a scrap of old paper for centuries, then the world learns to read again.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.note: A man keeps careful notes about an endless house of statues and tides. His notes are the whole story.

books.title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.note: Two stubborn magicians bring magic back to England, with footnotes and a great deal of vanity.

books.title: The Remains of the Day
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.note: A butler drives across England and, without meaning to, tells you everything he has decided not to feel.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.note: An artificial friend watches a family and understands less than she thinks.

books.title: Beloved
books.author: Toni Morrison
books.note: A house in Ohio, a mother, and a child who comes back.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: N. K. Jemisin
books.note: A world that keeps breaking, and the people blamed for it.

books.title: The City We Became
books.author: N. K. Jemisin
books.note: New York wakes up as five people and has to defend itself from something patient.

books.title: Mexican Gothic
books.author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
books.note: A young woman visits a cousin's strange house and refuses to be polite about it.

books.title: The Thursday Murder Club
books.author: Richard Osman

books.title: Washington Black
books.author: Esi Edugyan
books.note: A boy escapes a sugar estate with a scientist and keeps travelling to stay free.

books.title: The Midnight Bargain
books.author: C. L. Polk
books.note: A young woman is offered marriage or magic, and decides the offer is the problem.

books.title: A Tale for the Time Being
books.author: Ruth Ozeki
books.note: A diary washes up on a BC beach and a writer in Tokyo starts looking for its author.

books.title: Braiding Sweetgrass
books.author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
books.note: A botanist and a member of the Potawatomi Nation writes about plants as relatives.

books.title: Thinking in Systems
books.author: Donella Meadows
books.note: A short book on why fixing one part of a system usually moves the problem.

books.title: The Library Book
books.author: Susan Orlean

books.title: Moon of the Crusted Snow
books.author: Waubgeshig Rice

books.title: Moon of the Turning Leaves
books.author: Waubgeshig Rice
books.note: Twelve years later, a family walks south to find out what is left.

books.title: The Sentence
books.author: Louise Erdrich

books.title: The Wager

books.title: The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida
